items.text: Nico Collins listed OUT or DOUBTFUL (hamstring) for Sunday vs CIN after Wednesday practice injury; prior hamstring history noted.
items.why: Hamstring suffered at Wednesday practice; ruled out Friday.
items.implication: HOU WR room thinned (routes last week: Collins 37/42); deep flex on Hutchinson/Boutte/Noel and TE bump for Schultz.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for remaining HOU pass-catchers

items.text: Zay Flowers (and Ja'Kobi Lane) OUT or DOUBTFUL for Sunday vs NO; Flowers hamstring.
items.why: Hamstring; multiple DNPs; Lane on IR (wrist).
items.implication: BAL WR hierarchy collapses to Bateman etc.; crumbs remaining.
items.opportunity: Elevated snaps/targets for remaining BAL WRs and TE volume (Andrews/Likely)

items.text: Ladd McConkey QUESTIONABLE (ribs) after practicing Friday; biggest slate injury per Levitan.
items.why: Ribs; DNP early week, limited/practice Friday; game 4pm ET.
items.implication: Affects Herbert and entire LAC offense projections; late decision.
items.opportunity: If OUT, routes/targets to Quentin Johnston and others; Herbert downgrade risk

items.text: Brock Bowers OUT or DOUBTFUL (knee) vs LAC.
items.why: Knee; HC Kubiak; will test pregame.
items.implication: Michael Mayer elevated for TE volume in LV.
items.opportunity: Mayer snaps/routes/targets spike if Bowers inactive

items.text: Ladd McConkey (ribs) is the biggest injury on the slate; affects many projections including Justin Herbert. Game starts 4pm ET; ETR will update immediately.
items.why: Rib injury uncertainty cascades to LAC pass game and Herbert.
items.implication: Monitor status closely; Herbert and LAC WRs projections volatile.
items.opportunity: Role expansion for LAC secondary WRs if OUT

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson IN and ready; Patriots desperate for playmakers with AJ Brown on IR. Unclear how many touches vs Stevenson, but potential 10+ in debut amid favorable upcoming schedule.
items.why: Returning at right time; NE needs explosives; nice matchups pre-bye.
items.implication: Monitor for early-season RB2/flex upside and Stevenson split.
items.opportunity: Carries, routes, red-zone share expansion in NE backfield

items.text: Joe Burrow QUESTIONABLE (back) but said he's playing; coach supportive.
items.why: Back; self and coach comments lean play.
items.implication: CIN offense full-strength expected; Chase/Higgins stack intact.

items.text: AJ Brown OUT or DOUBTFUL (ankle, IR/return).
items.implication: NE WR room crumbs; boosts other NE pass catchers and Henderson opportunity.
items.opportunity: Increased targets for remaining NE WRs

items.text: Alvin Kamara listed IN; reduces Etienne/Miller committee squeeze.
items.implication: NO backfield reverts toward Kamara lead; Etienne passing-game lean further limited.
items.opportunity: Kamara snaps/carries/RZ; reverse prior Miller/Etienne beneficiary

items.text: Kenneth Walker LOVE Week 2 vs IND: 21/24 RB touches (74% snaps) through 3Q W1, 40% target rate on routes; Indy just allowed 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry.
items.why: Dominant W1 usage + elite matchup vs weak IND run D.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty LOVE @ LAC: 99 utilization W1 (tied Bijan), 19% target share recent, 25+ touches in 3 of last 4.
items.opportunity: High snap, carry, target, and RZ share

items.text: Justin Jefferson LOVE @ CHI: 37% target share from Wentz W1; 93 yds/18 PPG career avg with Wentz; CHI D soft vs WRs.
items.why: Wentz chemistry + matchup vs soft CHI secondary.
items.opportunity: High target share continues with Wentz

items.text: DeVonta Smith LOVE @ TEN: 27% target share, 13.7 aDOT W1; TEN soft vs WRs (85% catch, 16 YPR allowed).
items.why: Strong W1 usage + favorable TEN matchup.

items.text: Travis Etienne HATE @ BAL (Kamara back squeezes role; underdog script); Marvin Harrison Jr. HATE vs SEA (8% tgt share W1, zero RZ, SEA tough vs WRs).
items.why: Etienne: committee + negative script; MHJ: low involvement + tough matchup.
items.implication: Sit/flex down or bench both; prefer other options.
items.conflict: Kamara IN further confirms Etienne fade
